newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow to moderate in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt lower. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 65.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 65.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 950-1150 lbs 63.50-64.50. Select and Choice 2-4 1200 lbs Heiferettes 61.00.
Wk to Date - 44,900 Last Week - 108,900 Year Ago - 109,000
Sales reported on 10,100 slaughter steers and 8,200 heifers; 44,900 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 26,600 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
